items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves (A/D sideways, W/S vertical). Arrow keys FIRE tears in that direction, never move the player; tears travel slowly. E drops a bomb at feet. Q and Space showed no effect — don't retry. Movement ~0.06–0.09 room-width per 0.4–1.0s; rocks block — step laterally instead of re-pressing. Doorways/trapdoors need centered, sustained walking; standing ON a frame blocks the warp (step back, re-center, re-approach). HUD counters update one observation late.

TECH X / LASER (major mechanic): white pill pickup grants Tech X goggles (small white rectangle at the player's face = goggles worn, persists across rooms). Pill is at the two-poop room's hatch landing but was NOT visible on a later re-entry this run — respawn claim now uncertain. Firing spawns a lingering (~1s) laser ring at a FIXED OFFSET ≈0.2 room-units in the firing direction from the player (confirmed by standing ~0.2 below a target and hitting it; also explains earlier point-blank misses). Possible small x offset (~-0.03) when firing Up. Ring grinds anything it overlaps; trails of red cracks on props/rocks are NOT damage. Ring destroyed poop piles in the two-poop room and in the torch room (once). Ring did NOT open the torch-room gray chest (2 sustained trials; chest returned to unmarked closed state). Plain tears previously opened gray metal chests at a distance.

POOP PILES / DROPS: piles take ~4–6+ ring hits to destroy. Drops are unreliable/random: coins ('$') dropped and one was collected (counter went 00→01 by exact walking overlap); some gold specks linger but don't register. In the torch room a poop pile appeared to regenerate/stop taking damage after many hits — grinding it repeatedly is unproductive. Two-poop-room piles reset to intact appearance on each re-entry.

COINS/PICKUPS: coins collected only by near-exact overlap. Blue orbs = soul hearts (blue hearts). Heart pickup at full hearts → +1 bomb (earlier). Bomb blasts spawned a blue soul-heart orb in two runs — possible soul-heart source (never stand close).

CHESTS: gray chests open by contact or firing; drop heart and/or bomb; re-close on re-entry. Torch-room central gray chest sits in a tight triangular rock ring; its gaps are narrower than the player sprite so contact is impossible; firing/ring is blocked by the ring — needs a bomb to clear rock (bombing worked before, blast radius ~2 tiles). Red-lidded chests and spike-ringed red chest unopened (no key ever seen; what opens them unknown). White slit/mark on a fired-at chest: meaning UNRESOLVED.

BOMBS: E places at feet, countdown sparks ~1s, radius ~2 tiles; 1.2s retreat was NOT enough (lost a heart), retreat 2s+ or leave the room. Clears rock rings, does nothing to white spike rings or decorative cracks.

KEYHOLE DOOR: rock-field left wall, ~(0.19, 0.44). Repeated sustained walking into it with key counter reading 01 did NOT open it (3–4 attempts, multiple heights y~0.44–0.55). Plain tear fired at it did nothing. A laser-ring attempt was just initiated — result not yet observed; this is the leading open test. UNCERTAIN whether the HUD "01" is actually a key count or whether the door is operable at all.

HAZARDS: rock-field white round-faced hoppers are the deadliest known: they warp/teleport (arrive at doorways), self-ring with spiky rocks, transform into a winged/spread form, leave green splatter and drifting black dot projectiles; one visit cost 2 hearts. Stay 2+ tiles clear; avoid room center. Dark chest room (black spiders/blobs, melee chasers, laser ineffective) is a heart-draining dead end — AVOID. Corner torches damage on contact; a diagonal path past the bottom-right torch was walked safely. Blue flies in poop rooms hover and fire blue tears (ranged); damage amount unconfirmed. Death = empty grey heart outlines + bloodied sprite.

MAP / ROUTES (confirmed this run): Tutorial: top trapezoid x~0.50 ↔ rock-field (both ways — the earlier guess that rock-field's bottom exit was blocked is WRONG); bottom trapezoid x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room; right-wall doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room. Torch room: top alcove x~0.50 ↔ tutorial (both ways); top of room/left lane x~0.31–0.36 is a clear column; bottom gold trapdoor x~0.50 ↔ two-poop room (works from ~0.1 above the frame at y~0.67–0.70; needs x-center, sometimes several presses). Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1–0.2 below the frame). Rock-field: top exit → TNT room. TNT room: TNT barrels line the left wall and block lanes; gray chests wedged among them (~y0.30 and ~y0.63); red-lidded brown barrel by the lower one. Beyond TNT room: pink-enemy rock room (two pink fat enemies, poop pile with blue flies).

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door (laser test pending) and the red-lidded/spiked chests; whether "01" in the HUD is keys; meaning of the white mark on chests; whether chest contents/coin drops are random per run; whether the Tech X pill respawns; whether lasers can ever open a chest through a rock ring (current evidence: no); why the torch-room ringed chest resists both contact and lasers.

DURABLE GOALS: recover hearts (health has been critically low), obtain bombs, open gray chests, avoid the rock-field center and the dark chest room.
